heading: Definition of company’s share and policyholder’s share

tree.heading: Company’s share
tree.text: For purposes of section 805(a)(4), the term “company’s share” means, with respect to any taxable year beginning after December 31, 2017, 70 percent.

tree.heading: Policyholder’s share
tree.text: For purposes of section 807, the term “policyholder’s share” means, with respect to any taxable year beginning after December 31, 2017, 30 percent.
